{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:SWR_Woldar.png]] |name=Woldar |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Chimaera's bridge officer corps|''Chimaera''{{'s}} bridge officer corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Sir, one rebel ship escaped the blockade.|Woldar, to Grand Admiral Thrawn|}} '''Woldar''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] where he served in [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] by [[2 BBY]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|The rebels who escaped Atollon must be tracked down and eliminated before they can regroup and join with other cells.''"
"''I agree. But the Seventh Fleet and Commander Woldar can deal with that without you for now. Grand Moff Tarkin will also be joining the commander while his new assignment is being prepared for him.|Grand Admiral Thrawn and Emperor Palpatine|''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]''}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Imperial officer|officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy|Navy]], Woldar was a [[commander]] in the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] and often reported to [[Grand Admiral]] Thrawn.{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}} In [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' during the [[Battle of Atollon]], Woldar was present on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Chimaera'', and reported to Thrawn that a [[Nightbrother (Gauntlet fighter)|ship]] had escaped their [[blockade]]. Although most of the rebels eventually escaped, their [[Chopper Base|base]] was destroyed. In the aftermath of the battle, Woldar was assigned by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] with guiding the Seventh Fleet in a search for the rebels who escaped [[Atollon]]. He was to be joined by [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] in this assignment. [[1 BBY|A year later]], Woldar was aboard the ''Chimaera'' during the [[attack on Lothal]]. When [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]]'s [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] strike force of [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s emerged from [[hyperspace]], Woldar counted 24 [[starship]]s. In response, Thrawn deployed several [[TIE series|TIE fighters]], including the new [[TIE/D Defender Elite]] prototype [[pilot]]ed by Commander [[Vult Skerris]], to intercept the intruders. After Syndulla steered Skerris into an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|Imperial light cruiser]] and a [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]], Woldar reported the damage to the Grand [[Admiral]]. Thrawn expressed regret but praised General Syndulla's skills as a combat pilot. Thrawn then ordered a second wave of TIE [[Starfighter|fighters]] to intercept the surviving Alliance crafts. Woldar would later report to Thrawn afterwards that all the rebel ships had been shot down, though some had managed to crash land within Capital City including Hera's lead fighter. When Thrawn asked on the status of the TIE Defender factory, Woldar confirmed it was completely undamaged much to Thrawn's satisfaction. ==Personality and traits== Commander Woldar was a human male with [[Color|brown]] hair and light skin. ==Behind the scenes== Woldar shared a character model with different Imperial officers, which first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|Season Two]] episode "[[Legends of the Lasat]]." One of the character models, Woldar, was first identified in the end credits of [[Zero Hour]] which first premiered on [[Disney XD]] on [[March 25]], [[2017]]. He was voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who also voiced the protagonist [[Garazeb Orrelios]] and multiple other characters in the series. In [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|Season Four]], Woldar's character model continued to be used to fill in several background Imperial officers. In "[[In the Name of the Rebellion]]," the model was used three different times for three unrelated characters,{{Rebels|In the Name of the Rebellion}} including for [[Captain]] [[Wells]].{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/in-the-name-of-the-rebellion-trivia-gallery|text="In the Name of the Rebellion" Trivia Gallery}} ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} {{1st}} *''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]'' {{Ab|Thrawn: Alliances (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}} *{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}} ==Sources== *{{Armada|set=Rebellion in the Rim|cardname=Commander Woldar|reprint=1}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Woldar |fi=Woldar |fr=Woldar }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Seventh Fleet personnel]]
